headlines.text: It was 2022 when Adam Page vs. Bryan Danielson went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.40 ? a five-star epic. Marking AEW Dynamite's debut on TBS, this was the rematch to their legendary 60-minute draw two weeks earlier, and it more than lived up to the billing ? both men were busted open bloody before Page finally retained with the Buckshot Lariat, in a match many later ranked among the best of the entire year.
It was 2024 when Wheeler Yuta vs. Komander went to battle over the ROH Pure Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.35. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Back on this day in 2022, the inaugural AEW TBS Title was crowned as Jade Cargill vs. Ruby Soho went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.51. Also on AEW's first night on TBS, this was the final of the inaugural TBS Championship Tournament, capping a run that saw the undefeated Cargill and the battle-tested Soho both fight through a full bracket ? Cargill sealed history with an avalanche Jaded to become the first-ever champion.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2022, it was title-change night for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as Jurassic Express vs. The Lucha Brothers battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.31 ? a well-worked match ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Closing out AEW's TBS premiere alongside the Page-Danielson main event, Jungle Boy and Luchasaurus finally captured tag gold ? Luchasaurus put Rey Fenix through a table at ringside before Jungle Boy sealed it with a pinning reversal on Penta El Zero Miedo, giving the team its first-ever title reign after over two years together.
On this day in 2024, Hardys & Briscoe kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.36.
Looking back to 2022, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Malakai Black and Brian Pillman Jr. on Dynamite, rated 4.84.
